Fill in the required details in the online application form.

important_instructions: The engagement is purely on a contractual basis for a period of 11 months, which may be extended further based on satisfactory performance on a yearly basis. The number of posts may increase or decrease. Candidates must submit an undertaking before joining stating that they will not claim for regular employment with Delhi Cantonment Board on the basis of examination. Candidates must keep themselves regularly updated by checking the hospital notice board or DCB website at https://delhi.cantt.gov.in. Applicants must abide by the terms and conditions of the Delhi Cantonment Board/Cantonment General Hospital and perform duties assigned by the hospital administration. No TA/DA is payable for appearing in the Interview or Selection Test(s).

faq.question: Q1. What is Delhi Cantonment Board Gastroenterologist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Delhi Cantonment Board to hire 1 Gastroenterologist on a purely contract basis for Cantonment General Hospital, Sadar Bazar, Delhi Cantt.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Delhi Cantonment Board Gastroenterologist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Gastroenterologist post, which may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Delhi Cantonment Board Gastroenterologist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Delhi Cantonment Board Gastroenterologist?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a DM (Gastroenterology)/equivalent qualification, registration with the respective Medical/ Dental Council, and proficiency in GI Endoscopy (diagnostic & therapeutics).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Delhi Cantonment Board Gastroenterologist recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 50 years.
